# BeFra to Report Third Quarter 2026 Results on October 22, 2026


October 08, 2026 4:15 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_700f5713853348a881d08baa52fe343c/betterware/news/2026-10-08_BeFra_to_Report_Third_Quarter_2026_Results_on_107.pdf)


GUADALAJARA, Mexico--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Betterware de México, S.A.P.I. de C.V. (NYSE: BWMX) (“BeFra” or the “Company”) will report its third quarter 2026 results after the U.S. market close on Thursday, October 22, 2026. BeFra’s senior management team will host a conference call that same day at 5:30 p.m. (Eastern Time) to discuss the results.


The conference call can be accessed as follows:


- Dial-in: + **1-877-451-6152** (U.S.) or + **1-201-389-0879** (international); passcode: **13763048** .


Webcast: Available through BeFra’s investor relations website at[www.befra.com](http://www.befra.com/) or via the following link:[https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1777966&tp_key=38b58322dd](https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1777966&tp_key=38b58322dd)


An audio replay of the conference call, accessed via BeFra’s Investor Relations website, will be available approximately three hours after the conclusion of the call on October 22, 2026, through November 5, 2026. This can be accessed toll free in the U.S. by dialing + **1-844-512-2921** or internationally (toll) by dialing + **1-412-317-6671** and providing **** the passcode **13763048.**


**About BeFra**


BeFra (NYSE: BWMX) is one of the leading branded consumer products platforms in Mexico and Latin America, bringing together three iconic brands: Betterware, a leader in innovative home solutions; Jafra, a leading beauty and personal care company with operations in Mexico and the United States; and Tupperware, a leading brand in food storage and drinkware. Through these brands, BeFra operates across Mexico, Brazil, the United States, and an expanding footprint throughout Latin America, leveraging proprietary direct-selling platforms, world-class manufacturing capabilities, and a longstanding culture of operational excellence.
